title: Quasi-particles in weak perturbations of non-interacting quantum lattice systems
reading_depth: Definitions and Theorems 1–3, PDF pp.2–4; selected Section 2 ground-state expansion and references 23–24. The quasiparticle/scattering results are not imported.
supports: Possibly infinite-dimensional sites, unbounded gapped onsite terms, bounded finite-range perturbations; qualitative volume-uniform gap and canonical infinite-volume ground-state/generator.
limitations: The inspected constants c1 and c2 are existential, not numerically evaluated. Full cluster expansion not independently rebuilt. Original proof cited as JMP45,2134–2152 (2004); separate publisher text was not retrieved.
